items.item_text: Four years experience in the repair and maintenance of biomedical instrumentation, upon hire
Performs mechanical, electrical and electronic repairs and calibrations of all classes of diagnostic and therapeutic biomedical equipment.

Performs preventative maintenance and electrical safety inspections. As required by Industry standards and JCAHO regulations.Initiate purchase requests for repair parts and accessories; receives parts and equipment; maintains parts inventory records and accurate maintenance history records of equipment.
Performs incoming or acceptance inspections to determine compliance with manufacturers specifications and safety standards.

Demonstrates knowledge of patient care equipment Demonstrates increasing knowledge of the operation and underlying physiological principles, practical and safe clinical application of patient care equipment.

Demonstrate skills using diagnostic test equipment such as oscilloscopes, analog and digital meters, signal generators, frequency counters and special instrumentation designed for operational specification testing, and be able to interpret illustrative drawings, blue prints and schematic diagrams.
